scope: Counting measurements of a differential flux per bin: selected counts, background subtraction in reconstructed bins, optional unfolding, efficiency correction (separately, inside the response, or inside an effective exposure), exposure normalization, division by the bin width. Forward-folding, ratios, cross sections with luminosity and multi-bin fits are outside this table.

quantities.meaning: event counts in one bin, reconstructed or (after unfolding) true
counts divided by the exposure {X} (area x solid angle x time, or its effective form)
integrated flux divided by the bin width in the unit {E} the flux is differential in

effects.meaning: the estimated background count (possibly zero) is subtracted
bin migration is corrected by unfolding (reconstructed to true bins)
the selection (and trigger) efficiency is corrected for
normalized by acceptance or effective area, live time and solid angle

operators.meaning: N - B in reconstructed bins; the background estimate is for selected, uncorrected counts, so it comes before unfolding and efficiency correction
unfolding with a response normalized to selected events (inefficiency outside the matrix); efficiency is corrected afterwards
unfolding with a response that includes inefficiency (normalized to generated events): it corrects efficiency too
divide by geometric acceptance x live time (x solid angle) that contains no efficiency
divide by an effective exposure (effective area or acceptance x efficiency, x live time): it corrects efficiency too
